task.topic: Among surgically staged endometrial-cancer cohorts, is low-volume sentinel-node metastasis associated with recurrence compared with pathologically node-negative status?

pico.population: Patients with surgically staged endometrial cancer in a cohort reporting sentinel-node pathology and follow-up
pico.exposure: Low-volume nodal metastasis: isolated tumor cells or micrometastasis
outcomes: Source-defined disease recurrence recorded as binary events, with a secondary capture lane for source-reported time-to-event disease-free-survival effects.

outcome.description: Source-defined disease recurrence recorded as binary events, with a secondary capture lane for source-reported time-to-event disease-free-survival effects.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Capture source-supported ITC, micrometastasis, and node-negative arms separately. Preserve partial records and source-reported time-to-event effects instead of fabricating a binary contrast.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: A binary recurrence effect requires events and a denominator for both comparison groups. An adjusted time-to-event effect may be captured only with its explicitly source-reported estimate and confidence interval; it is not interchangeable with a binary risk ratio.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
